title: AOF 追加：appendfsync everysec 耐久性
expected_output:
appendfsync everysec:
  已落盘 AOF: [('SET', 'a', 1), ('SET', 'b', 2)]
  未 fsync 丢失的缓冲: [('SET', 'c', 3)]
  fsync 次数: 1 (远少于 always)
  耐久性: 崩溃最多丢失约 1 秒数据; 平衡性能与耐久(Redis 默认)
code:
def aof_everysec(writes, crash_at):
    aof = []
    buf = []
    fsyncs = 0
    for i, w in enumerate(writes):
        buf.append(w)
        if (i + 1) % 2 == 0:  # 假设每 2 条约 1 秒, 定时 fsync 一次
            aof.extend(buf)
            fsyncs += 1
            buf = []
        if i + 1 == crash_at:
            break
    return aof, buf, fsyncs

writes = [("SET", "a", 1), ("SET", "b", 2), ("SET", "c", 3), ("SET", "d", 4)]
aof, buf, f = aof_everysec(writes, crash_at=3)
print("appendfsync everysec:")
print("  已落盘 AOF:", aof)
print("  未 fsync 丢失的缓冲:", buf)
print("  fsync 次数:", f, "(远少于 always)")
print("  耐久性: 崩溃最多丢失约 1 秒数据; 平衡性能与耐久(Redis 默认)")
